title: OS command execution via Unix.system (ocaml) — review required
description: The ocaml sink Unix.system launches processes. Untrusted input in the command becomes command injection. This lexical rule flags the sink; the reviewer confirms arguments are trusted or passed as vectors via Unix.create_process.
remediation: Use Unix.create_process with separate arguments, never interpolated command strings.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any Unix.system call matches. Other languages' launchers are separate rules.
